# Evidence for this task

## Analysis population and correlation direction

| Matrix | Cell lines | Gene columns |
|---|---:|---:|
| CRISPR Chronos gene effect | 1,178 | 17,916 |
| Batch-corrected `log2(TPM+1)` expression | 1,673 | 19,138 |

Exact complete cell-line IDs and complete `symbol (ID)` gene labels are intersected, producing 1,103 shared cell lines and 17,676 shared gene columns. For each gene, missing values are removed independently and common nonmissing cell lines are aligned. All 17,676 genes have more than 10 pairs; the minimum is 283.

Chronos gene effect is inverted before correlation:

\[
\rho=\operatorname{Spearman}
\left(
\text{expression},
-\text{gene effect}
\right).
\]

Thus positive \(\rho\) means that higher expression is associated with higher inverted essentiality. No BH/FDR condition is part of the requested threshold.

## Descending correlation boundary

The five largest coefficients among all 17,676 genes are:

| Rank | Complete gene label | Paired cell lines | Spearman \(\rho\) |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | `CCND1 (595)` | 1,103 | 0.6288254699 |
| 2 | `FERMT2 (10979)` | 1,103 | 0.6123062053 |
| 3 | `KLF5 (688)` | 1,103 | 0.6020083868 |
| 4 | `WWTR1 (25937)` | 1,103 | 0.5595994040 |
| 5 | `ZEB2 (9839)` | 1,103 | 0.5220959205 |

The table is ordered over all tested genes; apply the inclusive coefficient threshold specified in the task to these ordered native values.

# Strong Expression–Essentiality Coupling in Cancer Cell Lines

**Authors:** Yvonne C. Lin, Martin J. Alvarez, Radhika Bose, and Stephen K. Durant

**Abstract**

**Background:** Large expression–dependency correlations may identify oncogene addictions and lineage-linked essentiality programs. **Methods:** Exact complete gene labels shared by batch-corrected expression and Chronos gene-effect matrices were aligned across common nonmissing cell lines. Essentiality was defined by negating Chronos gene effect, and two-sided Spearman coefficients were calculated for genes with more than 10 paired observations. No multiple-testing criterion was imposed on the coefficient threshold. **Results:** Nine genes had an expression–essentiality correlation coefficient of at least 0.6. These included prominent cell-cycle and lineage transcriptional regulators. **Conclusions:** A small set of genes demonstrates very strong positive coupling between expression and inverted Chronos essentiality across the cell-line panel.
--- END TASK EVIDENCE ---

Current request:
Intersect the expression and gene-effect matrices by exact cell-line IDs and complete gene labels.
For each shared gene, align nonmissing cell-line pairs and enforce the paired-observation threshold.
Calculate Spearman rho between expression and inverted gene effect for every eligible gene.
Sort the native rho values in descending order and inspect the boundary around the requested cutoff.
Apply the inclusive rho >= 0.6 threshold and report the number of qualifying genes.
